title: Cognitive Signal Envelope v1
description: One cognitive-plane observation crossing the MangoMas/harness boundary. Identity and telemetry metadata only: no field grants, transfers, or modifies authority (C-MMI-2). Documentation artifact; the enforced validator is harness/shared/cognitive_signal.py:validate_signal_dict.

schema_version.description: Exact-pin envelope version; any shape change is a breaking change.

run_id.description: Shared id joining all signals of one comparison run.

task_id.description: Deterministic digest of the originating task text.

producer_id.description: Role-shaped identity of the producing component (e.g. planner.shadow). Identity only; carries no permissions.

payload.description: Producer-defined content. Shadow plan payloads carry plan_sha256, elapsed_ms, and the provider usage object (R-MMI-6).

policy_id.description: policy_id of the governance policy in effect.

policy_version.description: Content digest (sha256 prefix) of governance-policy.json — not its schema_version.

producer_version.description: Artifact version or content digest of the producing component; the MangoMas digest for shadow producers.

parent_signal_id.description: Lineage: signal_id of the signal this one responds to.

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence artifacts backing this signal.

confidence.description: UNTRUSTED metadata (C-MMI-1): recorded verbatim for offline analysis; never a gate or control input.
